notes: Seed URL www.co.polk.tx.us failed (https: certificate not valid for that host; http: HTTP 403). One web search located the current site www.polktx.gov (CivicPlus). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The Elections page lists 'Cumulative Results-3-3-2026' and 'Precinct Results-3-3-2026', and 'Cumulative Results- 5-26-2026' and 'Precinct Results-5-26-2026'. Both precinct files are 'Precinct Results Report ... Unofficial Results' with per-precinct rows and Election Day votes, 'Precincts Reporting 22 of 22 = 100.00%': primary Run Time 9:53 PM Run Date 03/03/2026 (CreationDate Mar 4 03:53 UTC), runoff Run Time 9:28 PM Run Date 05/26/2026 (CreationDate May 27 02:28 UTC; file name 'Precinct-Results-5-26-2026-09-28-21-PM'). So precinct numbers with election-day votes were printed on election night, but the server stamps every response (PDFs included) with the request time as Last-Modified (e.g. Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:44:54 GMT), so there is no evidence of when they were posted online; END versus LATER cannot be decided by check 2. The 'Election Results Portal' (polkcountyapps.net/easydocs/election/) returned HTTP 403. The 2024 general is not listed on the current Elections or Election Results pages. Check 3 pending: origin/wayback-data not present.
